crossRefs.note: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of…
Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men…
Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and…
Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,
not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.
Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you…
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.
But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits…
A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.
For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.
The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.

translations.web: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect: not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.
translations.bsb: Servants, submit yourselves to your masters with all respect, not only to those who are good and gentle, but even to those who are unreasonable.
translations.kjv: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.
translations.asv: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.
